aligned_regime_hash7.honest_gap: Exhaustive Cas-OFFinder on hg38 for novel guides is not run (no binary). The mm<=3-restricted CIRCLE analysis is the aligned-regime proxy; a dual-labelled genome-wide-aligned + validated cohort is the remaining external validation.

verdict: cfBH's finite-sample FAR certificate holds distribution-free; a calibration-tuned threshold can violate the target on test due to sampling noise (see P_FAR_gt_q / p95_FAR). The aligned (mm<=3) oracle retains high burden fidelity, so the working regime is not an artifact of assay-restricted candidate sets.
